suggestions.name: National Institute for Educational Professional Development (NIEPD / المعهد الوطني للتطوير المهني التعليمي)
suggestions.focus: Government body established 2019 responsible for teacher and school-leader professional development across all public education; designs CPD pathways, licensing preparation programs, and cross-sector educator upskilling aligned with Vision 2030

suggestions.name: Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS / الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية)
suggestions.focus: National independent commission overseeing accreditation, postgraduate training programs, continuous professional development, and competency-based assessment for all health professions; designs curricula and examination frameworks for 38+ residency and diploma programs

suggestions.name: Saudi Arabian Drilling Academy (SADA)
suggestions.focus: Non-profit sector-specific technical and academic training academy (Saudi Aramco / TVTC partnership) offering diploma apprenticeship programs in drilling, well-control, and upstream energy operations; employs curriculum designers, simulation instructors, and HSE educators

suggestions.name: Higher Institute for Paper and Industrial Technologies (HIPIT / المعهد العالي للتقنيات الورقية والصناعية)
suggestions.focus: Non-profit TVTC-supervised technical training institute offering two-year diploma programs in industrial mechanics, industrial electricity, paper production and packaging, and supply chain management for Saudi high school graduates entering the manufacturing sector

suggestions.name: Classera
suggestions.focus: Saudi-founded edtech company (est. 2012) providing an AI-powered Learning Management System and Training Management System serving K-12 schools, universities, and corporate training clients across KSA and 40+ countries; roles in instructional design, content development, and educational technology

suggestions.name: Aanaab (أناب)
suggestions.focus: Saudi edtech platform (est. 2016/2019) dedicated to K-12 teacher professional development; offers Arabic-language courses in pedagogy, assessment, curriculum, and AI-in-education; provides Cambridge-certified credentials and school-leader preparation for Saudi teacher licensing exams
